choice.basis: The chart displays 'Month vs. Number of samples tested' with an inverted Y-axis (0.0 at top, 1.2e6 at bottom) and X-axis dates running from Nov 20 (left) to Jun 26 (right). Chronologically, the reporting window begins in late June (rightmost point) and ends in late November (leftmost point). At the start of the period (Jun 26), the count is approximately 0.4e6. By the end of the period (Nov 20), the count has increased to approximately 1.25e6. This represents a clear rising volume pattern over the reporting window. The task instructions direct the user to route the record to the operational follow-up that 'best matches the volume pattern.' The option 'rising-volume capacity planning' directly corresponds to this observed trend.
choice.option_label: Route the testing-volume record to rising-volume capacity planning
